id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bd8: "The witch is said to be hiding in Mirlean Forest in the Snaerfelt to the east.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c78: "But the forest has not only the witch but beasts she tamed, so be careful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d9c: "{var:1}, look at this blizzard. When I woke up, it had suddenly grown stronger. What happened?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e7c: "...What, you let the witch get away in the forest? How awful... This blizzard may be the witch's doing...!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f64: "So unless we defeat the witch, this country has no future... Oh, what should we do...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5068: "Unless we defeat the witch, this country has no future...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50f4: "But if she fled the forest, there's no way to know where she is. What should we do...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|53f0: "While I'm here, I'll protect Charlotte. They let me live here, so I should at least do that.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|54a4: "Besides, this girl seems to have many worries, so I plan to listen to them.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|55a4: "I won't freeze you again, so no need to be so wary. I don't have that magic left anyway.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5684: "Or do you want to be frozen in my arms? ...Hee hee.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5754: "Living in the castle, I wonder how everyone thinks and lives.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5814: "Strange. Before, I had no interest in what humans thought as they lived...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5938: "Come to think of it, I feel bad about that holy beast in Mirlean Forest.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|59c4: "Someday I'll apologize in the afterlife. Well, witches live long, so that's far off.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ea8: "{var:1}, thanks for coming. Hee hee, no need to be wary. I'm unrelated to this matter.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5f88: "How rude, just because I'm a witch. ...Well, I understand suspecting me, so I'll stay locked up for a while.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6088: "...More importantly, {var:1}. I have something to tell you about the Gold Plague.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6104: "That's no mere illness. I sense the magic of something evil and powerful. It's close to a kind of curse.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6220: "That one's power is strong, beyond me. Perhaps only you, the Luminary, could resist it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6580: "That one's power is strong, beyond me. Perhaps only you, the Luminary, could resist it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6300: "It's odd for a witch to ask, but please help my friend Charlotte. ...I'm counting on you, Luminary {var:1}.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6660: "It's odd for a witch to ask, but please help my friend Charlotte. ...I'm counting on you, Luminary {var:1}.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6458: "I sense some evil magic from the Gold Plague. It's no mere illness, better called a powerful curse.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|67b8: "You saved this country again. As expected of the Luminary {var:1}. I thank you as well.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|686c: "Still, to think the one controlling the Gold Plague was one of the Dark One's direct top lieutenants, a Six Warlord.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6944: "...I hear one of the Six Warlords is that handsome man who broke my seal. I feel a bit complicated.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a8c: "To defeat the Dark One, Mordegon, the Luminary really is amazing. No wonder I couldn't beat you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b78: "...Come to think of it, the man who broke my seal was used by the Dark One and met his end discarded.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c84: "Serves him right, but I pity him a little. Did that handsome man have no one like Charlotte for me?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e30: "You've come, {var:1}. You plan to challenge the black sun above Gallopolis, don't you?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ef4: "...How do I know? Hee hee, I'm a witch who has lived for centuries. I know without being told.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fc4: "...So I'll help you. That sun isn't beautiful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7074: "Listen. Get dragon souls and bring them to me. That's all you need to do.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7144: "Bring dragon souls to me and I'll turn them into mystical smithing materials that make super strong gear.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7244: "Evil dragons and Gigademons around Gallopolis drop dragon souls. Collect them as you gain battle experience.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7670: "Evil dragons and Gigademons around Gallopolis drop dragon souls. Collect them as you gain battle experience.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7358: "Now, once you get dragon souls, bring them to me right away. I'll be waiting here.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7784: "Now, once you get dragon souls, bring them to me right away. I'll be waiting here.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|750c: "Listen. Get dragon souls and bring them to me.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75b0: "I'll turn them into mystical smithing materials that make super strong gear.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|78bc: "Oh... you got a dragon soul. Shall I turn it into a material now?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|79b4: "Oh, a waste when it could become a great material. Oh well. Come back if you change your mind.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|86d8: "Oh, a waste when it could become a great material. Oh well. Come back if you change your mind.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7bbc: "Understood. Hihiirokane it is. Hand me the dragon soul.

tm.「{var:1}さん クレイモラン王国を\n 救っていただき ありがとうございま: "{var:1}, thank you for saving the Kingdom of Sniflheim. I can never thank you enough.
tm.「それに くわしくは存じませんが\n あなたは とても 大切な目的のために\n: "And though I don't know the details, you travel for a very important purpose, don't you?
tm.「やはり……{var:1}さんの\n その意志のこもった目を見ていると\n なん: "I thought so... Looking into your determined eyes, I somehow know.
tm.「私だけでなく クレイモランの民は\n 皆 あなた方の冒険を 応援しています。\: "Not just I, but all of Sniflheim's people cheer on your adventure. Please fulfill your mission.
tm.「そんな 隠さないでください……。\n {var:1}さんの 意志のこもった\n: "Please, don't hide it... Your determined gaze, {var:1}... I can tell.
tm.「{var:1}さん クレイモラン王国へ\n ようこそ！ 何か こまったことがあ: "{var:1}, welcome to the Kingdom of Sniflheim! If you have any trouble, don't hesitate to say so.
tm.「私たちにできることは 少ないですが\n この国を救ってくださった方を\n すこ: "There's little we can do, but we want to help the one who saved this country however we can.
tm.「リーズレットは 意外と\n この城の生活になじんでいるようですよ。: "Lizzlette seems to have settled into castle life quite well.
tm.「万が一 悪さをしても\n 私が きちんと しかっておきますから\n 安心してく: "If she misbehaves, I'll scold her properly, so please don't worry.
tm.「そういえば シャール。\n あんたが 好きだって言ってた\n 衛兵の子とは 上: "By the way, Charlotte. How is it going with that guard you said you liked?
tm.「ふーん なんにも 進展ないわけね。\n ちょっと 時間をかけすぎじゃない？\n: "Hmm, so no progress at all. Aren't you taking too long? If you dawdle, another girl will snatch him.
tm.「ああ もう じれったいわね！\n シャール あんた かわいいんだから\n もう: "Oh, how frustrating! Charlotte, you're cute, so have a bit more confidence!
